title: .Net Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET Core & Angular)


Salary: $5,500 – $6,500 USD per month (based on experience)

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM (EST)

Location: Fully remote (Latin America)


Latino Legends is conducting a search on behalf of one of our innovative, fast-growing clients in the marketing and digital delivery space.


Our client is a technology-driven marketing organization that builds and scales high-performance digital platforms for global brands. They specialize in developing advanced marketing systems, product delivery solutions, and integrated digital experiences that support microsites, social media, and complex backend operations. The company is known for embracing modern technologies, agile practices, and continuous innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Full Stack Developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and wants to play a key role across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).


The Role


As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a key contributor to the client’s technology team. You will go beyond implementation—helping architect, design, and scale applications that power a global digital ecosystem. From backend services to modern frontend interfaces, your work will directly impact performance, scalability, and user experience.


Technical Qualifications & Requirements


  • Experience: 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core/MVC, and Entity Framework. Experience designing RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Frontend Expertise: Advanced experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Angular (v12+), including state management, component architecture, and performance optimization.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, plus cloud platforms such as Azure (preferred) or AWS/GCP. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Software Craftsmanship: Solid understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, unit testing/TDD, and Agile/SCRUM methodologies.
  • Leadership & Collaboration: Comfortable mentoring teammates, participating in code reviews, and contributing to best practices within distributed teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect and develop scalable, high-quality applications using modern .NET and Angular frameworks.
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Maintain high standards for code quality through documentation, testing, and peer reviews.
  • Research and implement new technologies to keep the platform modern and competitive.


Why Join This Opportunity?


  • Modern, cloud-native technology stack with minimal legacy constraints.
  • Collaborative, professional work environment with high technical standards.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.
  • Strong work-life balance with PTO and recognized holidays.

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). title: Senior Java Developer
description:
A VMetrix é uma plataforma SaaS que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.


Propósito do Cargo

Como Senior Java Developer , você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.


Responsabilidades Principais:

Desenvolvimento Backend

  • Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração.
  • Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe.
  • Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção.
  • Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput.
  • Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas.


Design e Arquitetura

  • Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios.
  • Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos.
  • Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos.
  • Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas.


Banco de Dados e Integrações

  • Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados.
  • Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados.
  • Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais.
  • Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas.


Infraestrutura e Deploy

  • Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações WebLogic.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment.
  • Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes.


Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos.
  • Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe.
  • Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA.
  • Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas.


Colaboração e Crescimento

  • Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento.
  • Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java.
  • Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes).
  • Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design GoF (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema.
  • Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras.
  • Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte.
  • Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual.
  • Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/OpenAPI para desenvolvimento de APIs.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta.
  • Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning.
  • Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing.
  • Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs.
  • Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações WebLogic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares.
  • Experiência trabalhando em plataformas SaaS ou sistemas multi-tenant.
  • Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.


O Que Valorizamos:

  • Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana.
  • Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo.
  • Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness.
  • Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe.
  • Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real.
  • Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício.
  • Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar.


Processo de Candidatura:

  • Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo .
  • Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo.
  • Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência.
  • Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix

Na VMetrix , não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)


About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.


About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via , and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.


About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging HR and Finance executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .


Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email Director and above level executives to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (150+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.



Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

REMOTO

title: Analista de R&S Senior
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

Dentro desse ecossistema de soluções, a Equipo Locadora é especialista em soluções personalizadas para empresas que precisam de transporte sem complicações, oferecendo tecnologia, gestão inteligente de frota e atendimento próximo aos clientes. Com o objetivo de oferecer transporte inteligente e eficiente para empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos, sempre com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e inovação.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.


Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de Especialista em Operações Comerciais abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso:


Sua missão:


  • Identificar melhorias no processo de atração e seleção, acompanhando indicadores e planos de ação.
  • Efetuar a busca ativa de candidatos para vagas com alta procura e/ou de alta complexidade (headhunting).
  • Garantir a padronização do processo, execução das etapas de seleção e controle de vagas.
  • Realizar relatórios periódicos com informações de cunho gerencial da área (tempo de fechamento da vaga, número de vagas fechadas, entre outros indicadores).
  • Dar suporte à gerência e equipe nos projetos de recrutamento e seleção e no uso dos sistemas da área.



Requisitos:


  • Ensino Superior em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Sólida experiência em recrutamento e seleção (hunting, mapeamento de perfis, programas de estágio e trainee).
  • Sólida experiência com entrevistas por competência | Domínio em ferramentas de recrutamento (, plataformas de vagas, ATS)
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de RH | Vivência com projetos de employer branding
  • Excel Intermediário



Vantagens/Benefícios:


  • Ticket Alimentação - pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família.
  • Refeição no local - para garantir refeições mais práticas e tranquilas no seu dia a dia.
  • Vale Transporte - para apoiar seu deslocamento no trajeto casa x trabalho x casa.
  • Assistência Médica - cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama.
  • Assistência Odontológica - cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família.
  • Cartão Farmácia – facilidade e conveniência para cuidar da sua saúde e bem-estar.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral - proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados.

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
  • Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
  • Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);

title: FX Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Revel Street LLC helps corporate event planners discover and reach private dining venues through an extensive, dependable database. We use LLMs extensively to gather and enrich venue data, streamline the event planning workflow, and reduce the time and effort required to source options for events such as private dining, cocktail receptions, and conferences. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to help us improve data quality, fix existing data issues, and ingest more data from APIs and LLM-based sources to complement our current datasets. Our current stack includes React, TanStack, Cloudflare, Django, and Dagster, and we expect you to design solutions that are scalable, testable, and grounded in core engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

You’ll proactively turn ambiguous requirements into well-structured engineering plans. You’ll communicate trade-offs and risks early, and you’ll verify outcomes through hands-on testing. You’ll bring a “build, measure, improve” mindset to performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt pipelines for our analytics and operational workloads
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from multiple APIs and other external sources
  • Set up and manage workflows in orchestration platforms such as Dagster
  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack
  • Some experience with devops, CI/CD, and database management.
  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
  • Ability to understand data engineering fundamentals, not just generate code—debugging, reasoning about behavior, and ensuring correctness
  • Some technical college degree

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.


You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.
  • Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services.
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

Essa função tem como foco identificar novas oportunidades de negócio, fortalecer relacionamentos com clientes e impulsionar projetos estratégicos que estejam alinhados à visão da Emerson de inovação e excelência operacional.

Você estabelece metas desafiadoras e mantém padrões elevados. Você é decisivo e toma decisões de alta qualidade, mesmo quando baseadas em informações incompletas ou diante da incerteza. Você atua como um parceiro estratégico para construir, desenvolver e manter relacionamentos lucrativos e duradouros com contas-chave.


Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Graduação em Engenharia (preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica, Automação, Instrumentação ou Mecânica);
  • MBA em Gestão de Negócios ou Marketing altamente recomendado;
  • 7 a 10 anos de experiência em vendas técnicas, desenvolvimento de negócios ou gestão de contas estratégicas no mercado de óleo e gás;
  • Experiência comprovada em crescimento de mercado, negociação complexa e gestão de pipeline, preferencialmente no mercado de óleo e gás;
  • Português fluente e Inglês avançado (para leitura de manuais, treinamentos e comunicação com matriz);
  • Sistemas: CRM (Salesforce), Ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau);
  • Conhecimento profundo em instrumentação, automação e tendências digitais (IIoT, analytics);
  • Forte capacidade analítica e estratégica.
  • Disponibilidade para embarques em plataformas de petróleo para:
  • Inspeção visual de instalações e equipamentos;
  • Suporte a técnicos de serviços durante atividades críticas;
  • Geração de demanda de vendas por meio da execução de walkdowns e identificação de oportunidades.
  • Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro-RJ.


Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Junior Data Analyst - Remote, Brazil (New Graduates Welcome) Wowoo · Full-time · 100% Remote
description:
About Wowoo Wowoo is a global consumer technology company building AI-powered mobile applications used by millions of people around the world. Our portfolio includes ChatPrime, AI Baby Generator, and FaceForm. As part of our expansion in Latin America, we're opening entry-level positions for talented new graduates and early-career professionals in Brazil.

We pay in USD, work fully remote, and invest heavily in the growth of our junior team members.

The Role We're hiring a Junior Data Analyst to join our growth and product analytics team. This is an entry-level role designed for recent graduates or early-career analysts who want to learn from a senior global team and work on real, high-impact business problems from day one.

You'll help us understand how millions of users discover, subscribe to, and engage with our products, and your analysis will directly influence product and marketing decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Build dashboards and reports in BigQuery, Looker, and Metabase to track product, marketing, and revenue metrics
  • Analyze user behavior, subscription funnels, and marketing campaign performance
  • Partner with product managers, marketers, and engineers to answer business questions with data
  • Document findings clearly and present insights to a global team
  • Learn modern data stack tools and grow into a senior analyst over time

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree (completed or in final year) in a quantitative or analytical field: Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Mathematics, or similar
  • Solid SQL fundamentals (we'll test this) or strong willingness to master SQL within the first weeks
  • Comfort with spreadsheets and basic data manipulation
  • Strong written English; comfortable communicating findings clearly in writing
  • Curious, analytical mindset and attention to detail
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Internship experience in data, analytics, business intelligence, or consulting
  • Familiarity with Python, R, BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, or Metabase
  • Coursework or projects in statistics, A/B testing, or experimentation
  • Interest in consumer apps, subscription business models, or growth marketing

What We Offer

  • Competitive USD compensation, well above local market for entry-level roles
  • 100% remote, work from anywhere in Brazil
  • Direct mentorship from senior analysts and founders
  • Real ownership and visibility from day one - no coffee runs, no busywork
  • Flexible hours and async-first culture
  • Clear growth path to Mid-level Analyst within 18-24 months
  • Learning budget for courses, books, and conferences

Who Should Apply If you just graduated or are graduating soon, this is for you. If you've been doing internships and want your first full-time role at an international company, this is for you. If you're switching careers from a non-technical background but have strong analytical skills and SQL chops, we want to hear from you.

We don't care which university you attended. We care about how you think.

  • Wowoo is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets.


Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices.


Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).


Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making.


Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions.


Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity.

  • In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools.
  • Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS.
  • Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control.
  • Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.

Management & communication Skills


  • Experience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers.

title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About Voxy


Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.


Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.


We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)


We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.


Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.


In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.


As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.
